Found a production bug in apps/web/src/api/client.ts.

Root cause:
- VITE_API_URL is configured and correctly baked into the production bundle.
- However, client.ts never reads VITE_API_URL.
- send() currently calls fetch(path), so "/workflows" resolves against the frontend origin instead of the API origin.

Please fix this using TDD.

Requirements:
1. Inspect the existing client tests before changing code.
2. Add focused tests proving API requests use VITE_API_URL as the base URL.
3. Preserve the existing API paths (/workflows, /workflows/:id).
4. Avoid double slashes if VITE_API_URL has a trailing slash.
5. Keep the existing demo-key behavior and error handling unchanged.
6. Do not change API, shared schemas, database, deployment, or unrelated frontend code.
7. Run the focused client tests, full web tests, typecheck, and production build.
8. Report exactly which files changed and the verification results.

Do not modify anything unrelated to this bug.
</user_query>

content.text: The new tests fail because `fetch` still receives `/workflows` instead of the API origin. I’ll join `VITE_API_URL` onto those paths next.

`send()` now prefixes workflow paths with `VITE_API_URL`, so production requests go to the API origin. An empty base still uses the existing relative paths, and a trailing slash on the base is stripped so the URL is not doubled.

## TDD result
- Behavior: Workflow requests use `VITE_API_URL` as the base when it is set (`/workflows`, `/workflows/:id`). An empty or missing base keeps the relative path. A trailing slash on the base is removed before joining. Demo-key checks and error handling are unchanged.
- Tests added: collection requests go to `https://api.example.com/workflows`; by-id requests go to `https://api.example.com/workflows/:id`; a trailing slash does not produce `//`.
- Implementation: `resolveApiUrl()` reads `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL` and `send()` fetches that URL.
- Files changed:
  - `apps/web/src/api/client.test.ts`
  - `apps/web/src/api/client.ts`
  - `apps/web/src/vite-env.d.ts`
- Verification:
  - focused: `npm test -w @kisi-workflow/web -- src/api/client.test.ts` → pass (14 tests; the 3 new tests failed first on `/workflows`, then passed)
  - suite: `npm test -w @kisi-workflow/web` → pass (6 files, 51 tests)
  - typecheck: `npm run typecheck -w @kisi-workflow/web` → pass
  - production build: `npm run build -w @kisi-workflow/web` → pass
